scope: all same-name variants in corrected UI/item/template intersection
primary_review: Sol directly reviewed fixed Git objects, all tier overrides, actual template bindings, execution-chain applicability and the current player examples.

review_basis: Verified all 227 current file SHA-256 values exactly match the fixed Thunderstrike scope; no missing or mismatched inputs.

Read all 12 active formal pages. Each page is byte-identical to the corresponding file in frozen actual-preview-003; the six implementation pages, shared tier/formula/localization pages, and 13-Mark compatibility table are consistent.

Confirmed the active map row is melee Thunderstrike with six exact trait variants and 13 bindings; the six related weapon reverse pages link back to the matching implementation and names/marks. Actual UI receipt has 13 bound Marks and no outside exact items.

The six own implementations request I–IV target stack increments of 1/2/3/4. Their wrappers use the same confirmed base event route: held source slot, matching source item, and queued on_stagger_hit check; a living Minion target with buff extension must still be staggered when that event is processed. The trigger need not see the target staggered before the attack, and no additional attack-type or positive-damage gate is claimed.

The standalone target buff supplies unconditional impact_modifier 0.1 per effective stack for 5 seconds, with 8 effective stat stacks; helper request count is separately limited at 31, where a qualifying zero-add event still refreshes duration. Target impact terms are additive around neutral 1, and this modifier is not damage.

The two examples name actual Marks and profiles: Crucis Mk II heavy/light gives the controlled 100→140 impact-input example at four effective stacks; Munitorum Mk III shovel heavy/light gives 136→144 when effective stacks move from 7 to 8. Both examples state neutral assumptions and distinguish percentage-point change from relative increase; neither claims a fixed health-damage or guaranteed-stagger result.

Special-action coverage matches the actual paths: shovel M1 uses axe_stab; M2/M3 may emit item-preserving light/heavy sticky follow-up Attacks that pass gates independently; Devil’s Claw parry is not itself a hit but its counter sweep may be; power-maul/Crusher activation explosions are separate Attacks; Slab Shield special block is not an enemy hit; Thunder Hammer special activation is a no-op and its later player-side disorientation/push emits no second enemy Attack, while the powered sweep remains independently eligible.

Switching closes the held source gate while already applied target buffs continue their own 5-second expiry; true slot unequip removes the on_equip source buff. RAW name/description keys and hashes match across languages, formatter parameters rebuild all four tiers, image receipt identifies actual icon 175 and its verified attachment.
